steps.label: PGC3 outcome loaded
steps.detail: 7,659,767 variants, European autosomes, 52,017 cases / 75,889 controls (Trubetskoy et al. 2022, public v3 release)

steps.label: exposures passing the SMR instrument threshold (p < 5e-08)
steps.detail: SMR estimates a ratio, so a weak instrument makes it explode. The number of testable genes differs by rung and is part of the Stage 2 answer, not a nuisance.

steps.label: exposures matched to a PGC3 variant by rsID
steps.detail: rsID join. Unmatched variants are typically absent from the GWAS imputation panel.

steps.label: variants with a reconcilable allele pair
steps.detail: An unreconciled pair cannot be oriented, and guessing would flip the sign of b_xy for an unknown subset.

steps.label: variants surviving the strand-ambiguity filter
steps.detail: 8,798 A/T or C/G variants excluded: they are identical on either strand, so allele matching alone cannot orient them.
